title: MCQ: While iterating, which list survives? Code:

tests.name: B B
tests.code:
String out = CjTestBase.capture(() -> Solution.program());
CjTestBase.checkTrue(out.startsWith("B"), "the chosen option's explanation (starts with the letter)");
tests.hint: B. Removals shift later elements left, so index 1 lands on 'b' (kept) and the final 'x' at index 2 is removed. A student picking A assumed every x was removed; C forgets order; D ignores the loop entirely. Verified by execution.
